title: A Unifying Framework for Action-Conditional Self-Predictive Reinforcement Learning
author: arXiv.org
summary: The text discusses the importance of learning good representations in Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents. It introduces an action-conditional self-predictive objective (BYOL-AC) that outperforms existing algorithms in various environments. The study aims to bridge the gap between theoretical insights and practical implementations of self-predictive representation learning in RL.
